# discord_thread (List Resource)

Lists the active (not archived) threads and forum posts of a server, or of one channel, newest first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "discord_thread" "all" {
  provider         = discord
  include_resource = true

  config {
    server_id = var.server_id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild) to list active threads of.

### Optional

- `channel_id` (String) Only list the active threads of this channel.
